## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For rate or tax changes, link the
official source and identify the affected service class, location and dates.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local checks and automated tests pass.
- [ ] Runtime dependency pins match both requirements.txt and the HA manifest.
- [ ] No private invoices, account information, credentials or location data are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated when needed.
